description: If every clause of \(\Delta\) is derivable from \(\Gamma\), every clause derivable from \(\Delta\) is derivable from \(\Gamma\) by replacing premise leaves with their derivations.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.compose.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  {Γ Δ : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSet α} {C : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Clause α}
  (h : ∀ D ∈ Δ, Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Derives Γ D) (d : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Derives Δ C) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Derives Γ C
